desc: Mohawk: a tall stiff spiked mohawk dyed hot pink (no green anywhere) - hair only, on the bald ogre head, no hat

Brandy Snifter: a big balloon brandy glass held by its bowl in the fist, filled with dark amber brandy, the glass drawn with solid white highlights so it reads as glass (not see-through to the background)
Hair Curlers: a flowery headscarf knotted at the top over a row of pink plastic hair curlers peeking out at the front
